newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's CEI buys Federal media stake.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's CEI buys Federal media stake.

text.p: Argentina's CEI Citicorp Holdings SA has paid $200 million for 40 percent of media holding Grupo Federal de Comunicaciones, according to a report in El Cronista newspaper Wednesday.
The group comprises television channel Telefe, Radio Continental and publisher Editorial Atlantida. The acquisition price would not include the group's assets, valued at $100 million.
Officials at CEI, which is about 40 percent indirectly owned by Citibank, were not immediately available for comment. If confirmed, it would be the third major deal announced by CEI this week.
CEI has signed a preliminary deal with Tele-Communications International (TCI) and Eduardo Eurnekian to buy 64.5 percent of Argentine cable television operator Cablevision SA.
It also bought 33.34 percent of television sports channel and producer Torneos y Competencias.
